source: FTG Holdings Ltd consolidated and separate financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of financial position and consolidated statement of cash flows (audited; PDF published by the issuer at admin.flametreegroup.com on 8 May 2026 and 3 June 2026), Kenya shillings. CRON 20261117: the FY2025 column was written from the audited statement, and the FY2024 current assets and non-current assets corrected against the audited comparative column, which prints current assets 1,948,966,602 and non-current assets 1,779,218,107; the stored FY2024 698,529,879 was the inventories line and 3,029,654,830 was total assets less that line, a plug and not a printed subtotal. FY2025 total equity replaces the rounded 1,533,000,000 KPI figure with the printed 1,532,913,493. Gates: non-current plus current assets equals printed total assets 4,495,513,529; total liabilities 2,962,600,036 plus total equity 1,532,913,493 equals the same; non-current liabilities 735,716,097 plus current liabilities 2,226,883,939 equals printed total liabilities.
source_note: Farmed from the kenyanstocks.com statement API on 2026-09-21. Every cell is computed: line items carried from the source (0 where absent), group subtotals and statement totals computed by identity. No blanks.
